What happens
on the call

So you can decide whether it is worth thirty minutes before you spend them.

Minutes 0–10

What is actually broken

You describe the situation. We ask the uncomfortable questions rather than the flattering ones.

Minutes 10–25

What we would do first

A specific first move and the reasoning. You can take this and execute it without us.

Minutes 25–30

Whether we are a fit

Sometimes the answer is no, or not yet. We would rather say that than sell you a phase you are not ready for.

What will not happen

No deck. No pricing pressure. No second call to "bring in the team". If we can help, you will know by minute twenty-five.
